title: AAPS 3.4.0.0 - Gaps in network coverage when I leave the Wi-Fi network
symptom: When leaving and reconnecting to Wi-Fi, missing CGM data is not uploaded to Nightscout, and recording gaps are not filled. This started after updating to AAPS 3.4.0.0. The gaps only appear in Nightscout; AAPS and Dexcom app show no gaps.
cause: The thread identifies a bug in Nightscout rendering: Nightscout must be restarted to see backfilled data, but AAPSClient recognizes everything correctly.
fix: Restarting the Nightscout server displays the missing values. The issue is a bug in Nightscout rendering, not in AAPS.
evidence_quote: There is a bug in NS rendering (NS must be restarted to see backfilled data) but AAPSClient recognize everything correctly
